target_customer: Individuals first, then teams who want an AI agent with shared company context; priced from about $30 per user per month per one report
problem: Work context is scattered across todo lists, trackers, wikis and CRMs that are updated by hand and not built for AI, so agents lack context.
product_category: AI work agent with self-updating wiki

founders.name: Kushagra Chitkara
education: IIT Kharagpur, Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering (2023)

founders.name: Divit Sheth
education: BITS Pilani, BE Electrical and Electronics Engineering
founders.background_notes: YC page says the team previously built agent wikis for Harvard and NASA.

technical_complexity.rationale: Connectors to Slack, Gmail, Docs and GitHub plus an agent with browser and terminal and a wiki compile step; a review says the self-updating wiki runs as a daily batch, so real-time sync was not solved.

defensibility.rationale: Accumulated wiki context could create lock-in, but foundation labs and workplace tools ship similar agents and memory, and the product was still alpha with a waitlist in September 2026 per a review.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not yet observable; no incumbent action against Almanac specifically was found.

market_need_then: In 2026 teams adopted AI agents but had to hand-feed context; launch coverage and the YC post frame shared company memory as the missing layer.

identity.voice_and_tone: calm, tagline 'The most organised way to work with AI'

branding.community_and_virality: Launch HN post and coverage on small aggregators; no merch or fan content found.

brand_strength.rationale: Name collides with Almanac Health, an earlier Almanac document startup, the Farmers' Almanac, and an unrelated open-source Almanac tool, making search results noisy.

outcome_analysis: Almanac is a Summer 2026 company with three technical founders from Harvard and Indian institutes. It launched on Hacker News in late August 2026 and a September review found it still gated behind a waitlist. No outcome exists yet; the main exposure is that agent memory is a feature that larger platforms are adding, and the name is easy to confuse with other Almanacs.
